title: Electronic states in ideal free standing films
abstract: Exact and general results on the electronic states in ideal free standing films are presented. In many interesting cases, such as in FCC (001) films and in FCC (110) films, the energies of most electronic states in the film can be analytically obained from the corresponding energy band structure of the bulk. This approach can be further extended to obtain exact and general results on the electronic states in quantum wires and quantum dots.
